Freelancer Income & Tax Set-Aside Tracker
=========================================
Files
- Freelancer-Income-Tax-Set-Aside-Tracker.xlsx         : blank, ready to use
- Freelancer-Income-Tax-Set-Aside-Tracker-SAMPLE.xlsx  : same file filled with example data

Quick start
1. Open the blank file. Go to "Settings" and enter your tax year, currency symbol and set-aside %.
2. Add each payment on "Income" and each cost on "Expenses" (yellow cells).
3. Read "Monthly Summary".

Works in Excel, LibreOffice and Google Sheets (upload, then open with Sheets). No macros.
Google Sheets tip: if numbers look empty after import, press Ctrl+R once or reopen the file.

Not tax, legal or accounting advice. The set-aside % is your own planning figure.
Personal-use license: use it for your own business; please do not resell or redistribute the file.
Questions: reply via the store message system.
